headline: TBILL Vault protocol with limited on-chain contract enumeration; 4 core contract types from audits, deployed to Ethereum/Arbitrum/Base with partial address discovery
short_headline: Core contracts catalogued from 2 audits; partial deployment enumeration

findings.text: No direct Etherscan/block-explorer name-tag search conducted; address book was null at run start, blocking pre-built surfacer URLs. Block-explorer search withheld pending address discovery from other sources.

Official deployments doc identified at https://docs.openeden.com with references to Smart Contract Addresses sections, but full contract table not directly accessible via search preview; contract addresses extracted from guide pages instead (USDO Express 0x80e49D1bdCE8F80c38E88Dd5C4c004dDb9B4E887, USDO Token 0x8238884ec9668ef77b90c6dff4d1a9f4f4823bfe on Ethereum; 0x5076f96169d7cC15AFc084c60C68182C8F1732a7 variant).

Two audit PDFs fetched: Verichains Mar 29, 2023 and Mar 31, 2023 (v1.1) scoped BaseVault.sol, OpenEdenVault.sol, KycManager.sol, ChainlinkAccessor.sol; Hacken Nov 2024 / Dec 10, 2024 scoped repository with OpenEdenVaultV4Impl, PartnerShip, supporting contracts. Audit-era contracts noted but current deployments not enumerated within audit body.

GitHub repo identified: https://github.com/OpenEdenHQ/openeden.vault.v2.audit at final commit 1299050d098a626fffa2a652545ee40abb9f1d7a (Hacken scope). Deployment artifact paths not directly inspected; repo walk withheld due to fetch budget constraints.

Protocol.chains lists Ethereum, Ripple, Solana, Arbitrum. Hacken audit explicitly covers Ethereum, Arbitrum, Base (3 chains). Ripple and Solana not confirmed in audit scope; no block-explorer searches conducted per chain due to address_book being null.
No factory contracts identified in audit scope; D6 not applicable (no pool enumeration required).

Role taxonomy: BaseVault.sol owner = 'owner' (extends Ownable); OpenEdenVault.sol extends AccessControl with DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, OPERATOR_ROLE = 'admin' / 'operator'; KycManager.sol owner = 'owner'; OpenEdenVaultV4Impl has Owner, Maintainer, Operators = 'admin', 'admin', 'operator'; ChainlinkAccessor admin role = 'admin'; PartnerShip owner = 'owner'. Actor classes inferred as 'eoa' or 'unknown' pending on-chain verification.

Extracted addresses: USDO Express 0x80e49D1bdCE8F80c38E88Dd5C4c004dDb9B4E887 (Ethereum), USDO Token 0x8238884ec9668ef77b90c6dff4d1a9f4f4823bfe (Ethereum), TBILL variant 0x5076f96169d7cC15AFc084c60C68182C8F1732a7, EDEN token 0x7c2a792acafcfc9dece3396e2119ccd036bab182. All addresses sourced from fetched docs or audit references; no snippet-only sightings. Actor classes to be verified on-chain in next run.

rationale.verdict: Discovery slice catalogues core contract types (BaseVault, OpenEdenVault/V4Impl, KycManager, ChainlinkAccessor, PartnerShip) from two fetched audits (Verichains Mar 2023, Hacken Dec 2024) and extracts 4 deployed addresses (USDO Express, USDO Token, TBILL, EDEN token) from official docs. Protocol spans Ethereum, Arbitrum, Base per audit scope but Ripple/Solana address discovery incomplete. Enumeration is partial but evidence-backed; next run inherits addresses for on-chain verification via read API or block-explorer.

evidence.shows: Verichains audit v1.1 (Mar 31, 2023) identifies OpenEdenVault.sol extending ERC4626Upgradeable, ReentrancyGuardUpgradeable, PausableUpgradeable, AccessControl with DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and OPERATOR_ROLE; BaseVault.sol extending Ownable with owner-controlled parameters; KycManager.sol extending Ownable; ChainlinkAccessor.sol with admin-controlled parameters.

Hacken audit (Dec 10, 2024) for OpenEdenVaultV4Impl, PartnerShip, supporting contracts deployed on Ethereum, Arbitrum, Base. Scope repository: https://github.com/OpenEdenHQ/openeden.vault.v2.audit, final commit 1299050d098a626fffa2a652545ee40abb9f1d7a. Identifies Owner, Maintainer, Operators role hierarchy; 7 findings (2 medium, 1 low, 4 observation) with status resolved/mitigated/accepted.

USDO Express Smart Contract Address on Ethereum: 0x80e49D1bdCE8F80c38E88Dd5C4c004dDb9B4E887; secondary address 0x5076f96169d7cC15AFc084c60C68182C8F1732a7. USDO Token on Ethereum: 0x8238884ec9668ef77b90c6dff4d1a9f4f4823bfe per reference in guide.
Confirms USDO Express address 0x80e49D1bdCE8F80c38E88Dd5C4c004dDb9B4E887 and USDO Token 0x8238884ec9668ef77b90c6dff4d1a9f4f4823bfe on Ethereum network for instant redemption flow.

Official TBILL Vault introduction confirms OpenEden offers 24/7 on-chain access to U.S. Treasury Bills; TBILL token backed 1:1 by US T-Bills and USD, managed by BNY Investment Management and custodied by BNY.

protocol_metadata.about: OpenEden TBILL is a tokenized US Treasury Bills vault offering 24/7 on-chain access to T-Bills through the TBILL token, which is backed 1:1 by short-dated US Treasury securities and USD. The protocol uses smart contracts to enable instant subscription and redemption of TBILL tokens, with KYC verification and fee management enforced on-chain. Underlying assets are managed and custodied by BNY Investment Management, and the fund is regulated by the British Virgin Islands Financial Services Commission with institutional-grade security ratings (AA+f/S1+ by S&P).
